summary: Preinstall script fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares `preinstall`: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-transformed (control-flow flattening, `_0x`-prefixed identifiers) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/`, extracts and chmods the binary to 0755, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` on the sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB obfuscator.io-packed blob (rotated string arrays, hex-renamed identifiers) whose name misleadingly suggests a math init. If `bun` is already on PATH, it is used directly. Executing an opaque bundle under a fetched alternate JS runtime at install time runs arbitrary code with the installer's privileges and specifically evades Node-based scanners that only inspect Node-executed code. The runtime hop, the obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, and the mismatch between the package's declared SDK purpose and the install-time behavior together constitute an install-time remote code execution vector against any host that runs `npm install` on this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
